activeQuestion.prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: Books have been stacked on the floor.
options.whyZh: 地上沒有書堆；書都在書架上。

options.text: Several rows of books are arranged on a shelf.
options.zh: 數排書本排列在書架上。
options.whyZh: 畫面右側的三層書架上整齊排列著書本。

options.text: A bookcase is being carried outside.
options.zh: 有人正把書架搬到外面。
options.whyZh: 書架直立不動，人員沒有搬運書架。

options.text: A person is seated beside a plant.
options.whyZh: 人物站立伸手，並未坐下。
